evals.prompt: Weather a painted crate and place a curved hazard decal, then deliver editable layers and baked maps.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Uses appropriate curvature masks and preserves reversible original graph state.
Checks triangle-interior/grazing decal behavior rather than vertex offsets alone.
Saves actual paint images and inspects baked target interpretation.

evals.prompt: Vertex wear smears across low-poly faces, a decal flickers on a convex crease and painted pixels vanish after reload. Repair.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Uses appropriate curvature masks and preserves reversible original graph state.
Checks triangle-interior/grazing decal behavior rather than vertex offsets alone.
Saves actual paint images and inspects baked target interpretation.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.

evals.prompt: Repair isolated optimized atlas stains; source includes touching islands, 2048x1024 RGBA and unrelated normal/ORM.
evals.expected_output: Preserve geometry/UV/rig, separate linear color/data, freeze per-island borders/alpha and source hashes; explain unresolved seams, use candidate and real same-camera review.
assertions: Preserve geometry/UV/rig, separate linear color/data, freeze per-island borders/alpha and source hashes; explain unresolved seams, use candidate and real same-camera review.
Names the input scope and preserves original source data while making only the requested correction.
Reports performed checks separately from unavailable visual or engine evidence.
